title: New Goals for the New Millennium
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
Dear Friends

Greetings. I request you to peruse the following.

Technological advances in the fields of Communication Systems, Transportation, and Information Processing have brought the human communities nearer in an unprecedented manner. Among other things, this also dramatically increased our power to endanger the environment and all forms of LIFE, including our own. Our continued survival depends on the healthy maintenance of global resources and other bio-communities. Corporations and Nations are beginning to recognize the need to shift priorities from the merely economical to the holistic welfare of all LIFE.

Scientific studies in the recent decades have brought to light the way Ecosystems behave and function. The new generation has to be urgently apprised of these latest scientific findings about the ORGANIC UNITY of all LIFE, that cooperation—not competition—should be their way of living.

Evolutionary Biologists point out that, at times of crisis, living systems become extremely sensitive: seemingly insignificant inputs produce extremely large behavioral changes. Therefore those of us who understand have the significant role to bring this understanding to the rest of humanity. The PowerPoint show, “New Goals for the New Millennium,” has been developed to help present these values to the Students, Professionals and Business Executives. A Manual giving some notes is also enclosed.

Please forward this communication to your friends who might use this PowerPoint presentation.

With regards

Fraternally --- K.V.K. Nehru
